description: Worked as a cashier, shelf stocker, and customer service assistant.
Worked as a shelf stocker and warehouse associate.
Sold subscriptions for various charities and commercial organizations.
Promoted brands including Samsung, SkyShowtime, and Tombola by engaging potential customers on the street and at events.
Advised customers on finding and purchasing suitable shoes while also processing online orders.
Worked at La Place in Duinrell, operating the cash register, preparing food, and maintaining a clean workspace.

Shared end-to-end development responsibility with one other intern for two web applications for AEHT and Innotecs and one Flutter app released on iOS and Android. Used Symfony, PHP, Bootstrap, Flutter, Dart, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The delivered products remain in active use.

Progressed from general customer service to certified Klantexpert Tech, specializing in internet and Wi-Fi troubleshooting. Provided clear technical explanations and additional guidance to KPN and XS4ALL customers with complex questions.

Worked in a multidisciplinary Albert Heijn Labs innovation team on confidential projects involving multimodal generative AI. Developed prototypes with Kotlin, Spring Boot, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI; several concepts are progressing toward production release.

Contributes to supporting a cohort of 25 interns by advising on their projects and helping with Albert Heijn-specific infrastructure. Also maintains infrastructure and researches emerging technologies using Kotlin, Spring Boot, Next.js, Python, LLM providers, and Azure.
